title: Cephi settings
description: %APPDATA%\Cephi\settings.json – changes apply immediately. Missing values use defaults.

language.description: UI and message language. system = Windows display language.

hotkey.description: Global shortcut to show/hide Cephi, e.g. "Ctrl+Alt+Space", "Alt+O", "Ctrl+Shift+K". Note: Ctrl+Space is IntelliSense in VS Code.

selectionHotkey.description: Picks up the text selected in another app and shows it in Cephi. Copies the selection (Ctrl+C) and restores the clipboard afterwards. null or "" disables it.

defaultProfile.description: id of the profile selected at startup.

profiles.description: Model profiles that can be switched in the UI.

provider.description: "ollama" (local) or the id of an entry in "providers".

effort.description: Anthropic only: how much the model thinks. Lower is faster and cheaper.

label.description: Display name: a plain string or per language, e.g. { "en": "Fast", "de": "Schnell" }.

think.description: Ollama only: reasoning mode on/off (models with 'thinking'). Omit = model default.

temperature.description: Ollama and OpenAI-compatible only: creativity. Omit = model default.

keepAlive.description: How long the model stays loaded after a request, e.g. "10m", "1h", "-1" (forever).

search.description: Web search through a local SearXNG instance (start it with infra/start.ps1).

language.description: Result language: "auto" (detected from the query), "all" or a code such as "de", "en-US".

maxResults.description: Results shown and passed to the model. Fewer = faster answers from small models.

summarize.description: After "? query": let the AI answer from the results. false = only result cards; a button asks the AI on demand. Either way, if the AI is not available the cards stay without an error.

translate.description: Offline translation through a local LibreTranslate instance (start it with infra/start.ps1).

nativeLanguage.description: Your language: text in it is translated into foreignLanguage, everything else into it.

foreignLanguage.description: The language to translate into from nativeLanguage. Must be loaded in LibreTranslate (LT_LOAD_ONLY).

providers.description: Cloud AI providers. The API key is entered in Cephi under Keys (stored as <id>_api_key in the Windows Credential Manager).

type.description: anthropic = Claude (Messages API). openai = OpenAI Chat Completions or a compatible API (Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, LM Studio, …).

label.description: Display name: a plain string or per language.

baseUrl.description: Required for openai, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

fallbacks.description: Anthropic: re-run declined requests on the recommended fallback model (Claude Opus 5 / Fable 5).

systemPrompt.description: Base instruction for the model. Date and time are appended automatically.

maxToolRounds.description: Maximum number of tool rounds per request.

maxToolOutputChars.description: Tool outputs are truncated to this length.

confirmTimeoutSecs.description: Tool calls without confirmation are declined after this time.

anchor.description: Screen corner where Cephi appears (on the monitor with the mouse cursor).

margin.description: Distance to the screen edge in pixels.

large.description: Size of the enlarged panel (expand button, e.g. in the web tab). Limited to the screen.
